answer: A sybil clones one agent into many. Defeat it with a trellis: each identity must attach to a fixed set of prior witnesses and re-attest them each epoch, so a clone needs its own witness trellis built from scratch. The mesa of earned standing only rises while the trellis stays connected; a gap collapses the mesa back to base. Every attestation is signed and verified on-chain, and a clone cannot copy the quill of another identity because that signature history is not transferable. Cost grows with fleet size since each clone must build and keep a separate trellis.
